storage: Keep in an airtight dry jar away from light and moisture at room temperature, up to about 6 months once opened.
looksLike: a fine, bright yellow-orange powder with an earthy, slightly bitter smell; it stains hands and cloth yellow.
howToPick: a deep, even yellow-orange colour and a warm earthy smell; avoid a dull, pale or lumpy powder or a musty smell. Prefer sealed packs from known brands.
shelfLife: about 12 months sealed, per the best-before dates printed on packs (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 0.5 g per serving (¼ tsp, in the chicken marinade)
